title: The Walt Disney Company and OpenAI reach landmark agreement to bring beloved characters to Sora
description: Disney and OpenAI have reached an agreement to bring more than 200 Disney, Marvel, Pixar and Star Wars characters to Sora for fan-inspired short videos. The agreement emphasizes responsible AI in entertainment and includes Disney’s company-wide use of ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API.
author: Desconocido

title: Increasing revenue 300% by bringing AI to SMBs
description: Discover how Podium used OpenAI’s GPT-5 to build “Jerry,” an AI teammate driving 300% growth and transforming how Main Street businesses serve customers.
author: Desconocido

title: Strengthening cyber resilience as AI capabilities advance
description: OpenAI is investing in stronger safeguards and defensive capabilities as AI models become more powerful in cybersecurity. We explain how we assess risk, limit misuse, and work with the security community to strengthen cyber resilience.
author: Desconocido

title: How Scout24 is building the next generation of real-estate search with AI
description: Scout24 has created a GPT-5 powered conversational assistant that reimagines real-estate search, guiding users with clarifying questions, summaries, and tailored listing recommendations.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI co-founds Agentic AI Foundation, donates AGENTS.md
description: OpenAI co-founds the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation and donates AGENTS.md to support open, interoperable standards for safe agentic AI.
author: Desconocido

title: Launching our first OpenAI Certifications courses
description: Learn how OpenAI’s new certifications and AI Foundations courses help people build real-world AI skills, boost career opportunities, and prepare for the future of work.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI appoints Denise Dresser as Chief Revenue Officer
description: Denise Dresser is joining as Chief Revenue Officer, overseeing OpenAI’s global revenue strategy across enterprise and customer success. She will help more businesses put AI to work in their day-to-day operations as OpenAI continues to scale.
author: Desconocido

title: Bringing powerful AI to millions across Europe with Deutsche Telekom
description: OpenAI is collaborating with Deutsche Telekom to bring advanced, multilingual AI experiences to millions of people across Europe. ChatGPT Enterprise will also be deployed to help employees at Deutsche Telekom improve workflows and accelerate innovation.
author: Desconocido

title: Building AI fluency at scale with ChatGPT Enterprise
description: Commonwealth Bank of Australia partners with OpenAI to roll out ChatGPT Enterprise to 50,000 employees, building AI fluency at scale to improve customer service and fraud response.
author: Desconocido

title: Instacart and OpenAI partner on AI shopping experiences
description: OpenAI and Instacart are deepening their longstanding partnership by bringing the first fully integrated grocery shopping and Instant Checkout payment app to ChatGPT.
author: Desconocido

title: The state of enterprise AI
description: Key findings from OpenAI’s enterprise data show accelerating AI adoption, deeper integration, and measurable productivity gains across industries in 2025.
author: Desconocido

title: How Virgin Atlantic uses AI to enhance every step of travel
description: Virgin Atlantic CFO Oliver Byers shares how the airline is using AI to speed up development, improve decision-making, and elevate customer experience.
author: Desconocido

title: Introducing OpenAI for Australia
description: OpenAI is launching OpenAI for Australia to build sovereign AI infrastructure, upskill more than 1.5 million workers, and accelerate innovation across the country’s growing AI ecosystem.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI to acquire Neptune
description: OpenAI is acquiring Neptune to deepen visibility into model behavior and strengthen the tools researchers use to track experiments and monitor training.
author: Desconocido

title: How confessions can keep language models honest
description: OpenAI researchers are testing “confessions,” a method that trains models to admit when they make mistakes or act undesirably, helping improve AI honesty, transparency, and trust in model outputs.
author: Desconocido

title: Announcing the initial People-First AI Fund grantees
description: The OpenAI Foundation announces the initial recipients of the People-First AI Fund, awarding $40.5M in unrestricted grants to 208 nonprofits supporting community innovation and opportunity.
author: Desconocido
